question: Estimate the warehouse / logistics real estate opportunity in India by 2030.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total Grade A + B warehouse stock by 2030? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Current Grade A+B warehouse stock FY26: ~450 million sqft.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total annual warehouse REIT/investment opportunity: ₹25,000-30,000 Cr/year.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Current Grade A+B warehouse stock FY26

calculationFlow: Current Grade A+B warehouse stock FY26: ~450 million sqft.
Average annual rental: ~₹250/sqft (rising with quality demand).
Annual leasing market: 690M × ₹250 = ~₹1.7 lakh Cr in operational value.
Plus capex (constructing new warehouses): ~50M sqft × ₹2,500/sqft = ₹12,500 Cr/year.
Total annual warehouse REIT/investment opportunity: ₹25,000-30,000 Cr/year.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total annual warehouse REIT/investment opportunity: ₹25,000-30,000 Cr/year.
